notes.title: DEMO FAQ
notes.content:
[h2]When will this demo end, and when will it be available again?[/h2][p]We’re really sorry, but this demo will be removed on [b]August 4th[/b]. We understand this might feel unfair to players who just discovered the game and were hoping to try it out. However, the current demo still has many issues, and taking it offline will help us focus fully on developing the next milestone.[/p][p]We’re planning to bring the demo back on [b]October 16th[/b], during the Steam Next Fest.[/p][p][/p][h2]Can the demo be played in multiplayer?[/h2][p]Multiplayer is currently in [b]beta[/b] and still quite unstable. If you still want to give it a try, please make sure to [b]check "Multiplayer" (not "LAN")[/b] when loading a save or launching a new game, and invite your friends via [b]Steam Overlay[/b].[/p][p]If the connection fails, try verifying the game data or switching to a different person as the host.[/p][p]Unfortunately, [b]LAN is currently unavailable at the moment[/b], and we apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why is the demo in Chinese when I launch it?[/h2][p]Right now, we only support [b]English and Chinese[/b]. If your system language is something else, the game will default to [b]Chinese[/b]. We'll find a way to make English as the default. Right now you can switch the language by clicking the [b]“A” button at the bottom of the main menu[/b].[/p][p]We plan to support more languages in future updates. Thank you for your patience![/p][p][/p][h2]How do I unlock the automatic checkout feature?[/h2][p]You can unlock it via the [b]Upgrade Panel[/b]. Just press [b]Z[/b] and switch to the [b]Upgrade tab in the top-left corner[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2]How can I feed Iron Smelters automatically?[/h2][p]Via throwing devices like catapults.[/p][p][/p][h2]I have some feedback or suggestions about the demo. Where should I send them?[/h2][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts! You can share your feedback by filling out our [b]Google Form:
[/b][url="https://forms.gle/a53naMyVzFLi2jFr8"]https://forms.gle/a53naMyVzFLi2jFr8[/url][/p]
